research.notes: Could not confirm the legal entity 'Fare Resources, Inc.' in the CA Secretary of State registry (not fetchable). Link between Fare Resources and Just Fare rests on one press article; justfare.co does not mention the Fare Resources name. profile.summary: Fare Resources began in 2009 as a food and farm consultancy and later became Just Fare, a company that runs workplace food programs and office catering in the Bay Area. During the COVID-19 pandemic it also ran a community kitchen that donated meals to local organizations.

review.notes: Edible East Bay states Fare Resources evolved into Just Fare (then Emeryville-based) and that its Community Kitchen donated meals to OUSD; the CA filing for Fare Resources Inc. shares the 4300 Broadway, Oakland address shown on justfare.co. Summary, contact fields and entity number are all supported by the cited pages and the wording is neutral.
